# Transitions

Transition animation components

## Overview

- **Category**: utils
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: Transitions

## About

This is a Material UI component re-exported by Netline UI. For detailed documentation, please refer to the [Material UI Transitions documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/react-transitions/).

Netline UI may provide additional theming and styling on top of the base MUI component.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { Transitions } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<Transitions>
  Content
</Transitions>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's Transitions.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI Transitions Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/transitions/)
